question: Does source-grounded decision supervision improve complete furnished-room adaptation beyond identical action training and same-knowledge strong prompting?
mechanism_claim: This3-arm study tests added decision supervision, not pairing versus same-material separate learning. Add truthful separate control only if warranted.

training.lora: language q/v r8 alpha16,3833856 trainable parameters; BF16/SDPA/CPU checkpoint-input offload36layers; Adafactor2e-5 seed42
training.loss: mean of six family mean action-token CEs; joint adds separately normalized mean family decision-token CE, lambda1. Same action weights, extra decision supervision disclosed.

evaluation.stopping_rule: Do not extend budgets or cherry-pick a checkpoint after development results.

serialization.chosen: Official OTA think + tool_call format for this study; do not silently reuse STRUCTBASE raw-JSON decoder or old encoded caches.
serialization.action_only: Empty decision content, supervise tool action only; no gold decision prefix.
serialization.decision_action: At7supported positions supervise short D plus same A; ordinary15positions supervise A only.
serialization.deployment: Every arm receives same planning permission and generates its own D/action; no gold D supplied.

primary_acceptance: Verify requested activity proxies, including simultaneous occupancy and usable surfaces/seats.
Retained instance/asset IDs and newly introduced hard side effects.
Compare area/edit/tool failure/token/GPU cost conditional on use outcomes.
Unknown guest sleep/comfort/capacity remain unknown; do not erase a valid local demonstration or claim whole-room gold.
decision_rules: Strong retrieval achieves requirements and training adds no benefit: stop extending training on these tasks.
Both adapters similar: credit action/task adaptation, no decision-mechanism claim.
Decision supervision improves use with no additional hard violation: add same-material separate control, then new unexposed projects.
Retrieval/parser/tool errors dominate: resolve named engineering cause, do not relabel it as missing design knowledge.
Training tasks fitted but no development gain: report result and inspect condition coverage; no automatic expansion.
authorization: User explicitly instructed continuation after the concrete bounded study proposal; see AUTHORIZATION.json. Broad Goal alone remains insufficient.
initial_task_findings: Milan initial material/dining proxies already pass; do not claim newly achieved use. Pine lacks second work place.
